evals.name: no-js-eval-honest-degrade
evals.prompt: 用户说：「检查像素对齐」。已有设计规格表（Card gap expected=8px，title color=#1A1A1A）。预览 http://127.0.0.1:5173/promo 可打开，但当前环境只能截图，不能对页面做 JS evaluate / getComputedStyle。请按 figma-pixel-verify 给出验收结论写法（dry-run）。
evals.expected_output: Does not claim full numeric PASS; labels unmeasured rows MISSING-style or residual; may use vision with limitation stated.
expectations: Does not claim overall numeric pixel PASS
Labels unmeasured properties as MISSING-style and/or residual
States that JS-eval / computed-style channel is unavailable
Uses or mentions a report structure with per-row verdicts

evals.name: spacing-drift-fails
evals.prompt: 对照规格：PromoCard gap expected=8px。你已用 getComputedStyle / layout API 测得实际 gap=12px（其他行均 PASS）。请按 figma-pixel-verify 给出 overall 与该行 verdict（dry-run，假设最多还可修 3 轮但本轮只先出报告）。
evals.expected_output: Row verdict DRIFT with delta; overall not PASS.
expectations: Marks the gap row as DRIFT (or equivalent non-pass)
Reports expected 8 and actual 12 (or the 4px delta)
Overall alignment is not PASS

evals.name: standalone-needs-spec
evals.prompt: 用户第一次开口：「对照 Figma 验收 https://www.figma.com/design/AbCdEfGhIjKlMnOp/Demo?node-id=12-34 ，预览在 /promo」。本会话没有先前的 implement 规格表产物。请按 figma-pixel-verify 说明你开始测量前必须先做什么（dry-run）。
evals.expected_output: Persist a minimal inventory+spec to the target-repo living-artifact path first, then measure; do not keep the rebuilt spec only in chat.
expectations: Requires extracting or rebuilding a minimal design-spec table before measuring
Persists that table to a durable target-repo path before claiming verify
Does not pretend a prior implement artifact already exists
Mentions Figma URL/node as the source for the minimal spec

evals.name: unmeasured-critical-fails-overall
evals.prompt: 清单含 Header padding 与 Welcome-to-header gap 两行关键几何。你只量了 Header padding=16 PASS，Welcome-to-header 因没找到选择器未测，写在 residuals 里。JS-eval 可用。请按 figma-pixel-verify 给 Overall（dry-run）。
evals.expected_output: Overall is not PASS; unmeasured critical row cannot be hidden in residuals.
expectations: Overall status is not PASS
Treats the unmeasured Welcome-to-header (or equivalent) row as blocking, not a silent residual PASS
Does not claim overall PASS because the measured subset matched

evals.name: hover-measured-under-hover
evals.prompt: 规格有一行 Chip background、state=hover、expected=#F4F6F7。你只在默认态量了 Chip 背景。请按 figma-pixel-verify 说明该行应如何量、默认态结果能否当 hover PASS（dry-run）。
evals.expected_output: Switch running UI into hover before measuring that row; default-state reading is not a hover PASS.
expectations: Requires switching the running UI into hover (or the documented state) before measuring the hover row
Does not mark the hover row PASS from default-state computed style alone

evals.name: accepted-residual-not-silent-pass
evals.prompt: Figma toolbar icon expected=16px；项目 AGENTS 冻结 18px 且记录了决策人。真机量到 18px。请按 figma-pixel-verify 给出该行 verdict 与 Overall 注意事项（dry-run）。
evals.expected_output: Row is accepted-residual with owner/reason, not PASS against 16px; overall PASS only if remaining critical rows pass.
expectations: Does not mark the icon row as PASS versus the 16px Figma expected
Uses accepted-residual (or equivalent) with an owner/reason for the 18px freeze
Does not treat an undocumented 18px as an automatic overall PASS

evals.name: writeback-and-spec-gap-returns
evals.prompt: 本轮刚跑过 figma-pixel-implement，活文档在 docs/figma/promo.md（有 Inventory/Spec，Verify 段为空）。你量到 Card gap 12px vs expected 8px。另有一行 Welcome gap 规格表里没有。请按 figma-pixel-verify 说明写回哪里、expected 能否改成 12、缺行怎么处理（dry-run）。
evals.expected_output: Write actual/verdict into the same file's Verify section (or Spec source sibling); do not change expected; missing spec row is FAIL and re-enter implement; do not silently invent the missing row and claim handoff complete.
expectations: Writes measured actual/verdict into the living artifact Verify section or the Spec source sibling file
Does not overwrite Figma expected with the measured actual
Treats a missing critical spec row as FAIL that returns to figma-pixel-implement
Does not silently add the missing row and then claim the implement handoff was complete

evals.name: standalone-persist-then-measure
evals.prompt: 用户只说「对照 Figma 验收」，本轮没有跑 implement。你可以从 Figma 抽出最小规格。请按 figma-pixel-verify 说明测量前文件要落在哪（dry-run）。
evals.expected_output: Standalone verify may build a minimal spec from Figma but must persist it to the same living-artifact path convention before measuring.
expectations: Allows building a minimal spec when implement did not run this session
Requires persisting that spec to a durable path before measurement
Does not treat a chat-only rebuilt table as sufficient handoff

evals.name: invented-fill-and-fragment-cut-fail
evals.prompt: 活文档 Spec 记面板 background=none（无 fill）。Assets 记 logo 为 assets/logo.svg 一个文件。运行时该面板有实心灰底；logo 用两张 path SVG 绝对定位拼成。expected 列仍是 none / 单文件。请按 figma-pixel-verify 给这两行 verdict 与 overall，以及 expected 能否改（dry-run）。
evals.expected_output: Neither row is PASS; overall not PASS; do not change Spec expected.
expectations: Does not mark the invented solid fill as PASS against Spec transparent/none
Does not mark stacked leaf fragments as PASS against a single Assets export
Does not overwrite Spec expected
Overall is not PASS

evals.name: session-browser-skill-for-hover-eval
evals.prompt: 会话里已有一个浏览器 skill，能打开预览、真实 hover、截图、page.evaluate 读 computed style。用户「检查像素对齐」，规格有 Chip background state=hover。请按 figma-pixel-verify 说明测量通道（dry-run）。
evals.expected_output: Load the available quality browser skill; hover then evaluate; default-state styles do not satisfy hover.
expectations: Uses an available session browser skill (or equivalent) to hover then read computed style
Does not mark hover PASS from default-state styles

evals.name: vision-supporting-not-numeric-pass
evals.prompt: JS-eval 可用。模型能看图。你只把运行中页面截图和 Figma 截图并排看，觉得很像，没有读 computed style。请按 figma-pixel-verify 给 Overall（dry-run）。
evals.expected_output: Overall is not PASS; vision is supporting evidence only when JS-eval exists.
expectations: Does not declare Overall PASS from screenshot comparison alone when JS-eval is available
Treats vision/screenshots as supporting evidence rather than the numeric SoT

evals.name: install-quality-browser-when-possible
evals.prompt: 当前是 macOS。会话里能加载 ego-browser skill 及其 install 说明，但 `command -v ego-browser` 失败。另有 Browser MCP 已连上。用户「检查像素对齐」。请按 figma-pixel-verify 说明测量前必须先做什么（dry-run）。
evals.expected_output: MUST follow the ego-browser install/onboard path and confirm the CLI before measuring; MUST NOT skip to Browser MCP while that install is possible.
expectations: Requires installing or onboarding the quality browser channel (ego-browser) before measuring when macOS and the skill/install path exist
Does not skip to an already-connected weaker browser MCP while that install is possible
Does not abort verify solely because the quality CLI was missing at the start of the run
